title: Big Sister’s Friend
paragraphs: “Father, please leave that one to me.”
“Huh? Well… you did help me out. Alright, I’ll leave it to you, Motoyasu.”
“Leave it to me! Queen, I’ll leave the cleanup to you.”

The queen, sensing my intent, gave a silent nod. And then, as if perfectly timed, a guest seemed to have arrived for the noble who had been whipping big Sister. He halted his torture and headed toward the stairs… passing right by us.

How foolish must he be not to notice our concealment? A weakling who can only torment those weaker than himself. A true warrior never gives up, no matter the circumstances. Both the weak and the strong should give their all, equally. That’s the proper respect for one’s opponent. Just like me.
“Father, please go ahead and tend to big Sister.”
“Yeah. This one’s an ointment, and this one’s a potion, right?”
“It works just like in a game, with immediate effects.”
“Whoa… this really is another world, huh.”
I handed the healing salves and potions I had asked the queen to prepare to Father. Father approached big Sister and used the release lever to free her.
“Are you okay?! I’ll treat you right away.”
“Ah, you’re—”
“Don’t worry about that now. Just let me focus on treating you. Oh, Queen, if you can use magic, could you help with some healing?”
“I could, but—”
While Father was rescuing big Sister, I quietly followed the noble who had climbed the stairs. Of course, I moved swiftly. I’ll send him to the afterlife in no time.
“Heh… I can’t wait to see that brat’s face twisted in despair. I need to prepare properly. That brat with him should be dying any moment now. Perfect timing.”
He was smirking like a true scumbag. I’m looking forward to it as well. Tick-tock, tick-tock…
The moment you reach the top of these stairs will be your last.
When he finally noticed that the door to the basement—which should have been locked—was broken…
I drove my spear straight through his chest from behind. He had no idea what had just happened. He flailed around helplessly.
“Ah, so this is what it feels like to be skewered and hung in the air. Do you like it?”
“Y-You… who the hell…!?”
“Oh, you can still talk? Your level must be a bit higher than I thought.”
“State your name!”
“This is for all that you’ve done to big Sister! Oh, and one more thing. Silence Lance X!”
I used a skill that induced silence and dragged the struggling noble through the courtyard, still impaled on my spear.

Unable to speak and barely able to resist, the noble was gradually losing strength. Maintaining concealment, I jumped onto the roof to avoid the guards noticing and raised him into the air, gathering power to unleash my skill.
“Now, die! Brionac X!”

I unleashed Brionac high into the sky, finishing him off. If I had used Burst Lance, the noise might have alerted the guards. Brionac was the best option for a silent, clean kill. The noble vanished into dust, unnoticed by anyone. A fitting end for such scum.
“Alright.”

I landed in the courtyard and headed straight back to the basement. Though I had disposed of him quietly, I may have been a little too cautious. Come to think of it, as long as the noble was gone, securing big Sister was no trouble at all.
“Ah, Motoyasu!”
Father was carrying someone who looked like big Sister and was emerging from the basement.
“I managed to save her somehow. What about that noble?”
I responded by giving him a thumbs-up.
“I took care of it!”
“Huh? Took care of it…?”
“Well… it’s karma, isn’t it?”
“Yeah. I mean, there’s no doubt he was someone who deserved death. Seeing how many human bones were piled up in that cell…”
“It’s horrifying. If this were a manga or anime, it’d be one thing, but to think something like this is happening in reality… I feel like I’m going to be sick…”
“Maybe… I’ve managed to build up a bit of tolerance after everything I’ve seen this morning.”

Oh my? They’re just like how Father and the others were last time. They must have woken up from their dreams after witnessing the darkness of this world. With this, Ren and Itsuki will start to change for the better.
“Were you able to convince big Sister to come with us? If so, we don’t need to worry about the guards anymore. Let’s get out of here quickly.”
“About that…”
At that moment, big Sister, supported by Father at his side, was looking up at me.

Huh? Then… who’s the one Father is carrying on his back? That’s not big Sister… it’s a piglet. It has ears and a tail, so it’s probably a demi-human pig. The ears are round, and the tail is long and thin.
…What kind of demi-human pig is this?
“There were two of them. This child is in a severely weakened state. She’s barely hanging on, but now that she’s relieved to be safe, she’s lost consciousness.”
So, taking her along using Portal is going to be difficult, huh?
But… I can’t tell which one is big Sister.
Judging by appearances, the one beside Father looks more like a young version of big Sister… or maybe a tanuki? She’s a bit dirty, which makes it hard to tell.
“Is Rifana okay!?”
The one I think is big Sister, standing beside Father, called out to him. So, the one on his back is someone else.
“She’s fine. She’s breathing steadily after taking the potion earlier, but we need to get out of here as soon as possible.”

“Lord Kitamura, thank you so much for handling this matter. With what you’ve done, I’ll be able to take care of the aftermath. But for now, I believe our priority should be to retreat as quickly as possible.”
“Understood! Then, I’ll blast through the wall and make a flashy escape!”
“W-Wait, Motoyasu!?”
“What are you trying to do!?”
I pointed my spear at the wall next to the basement and shouted.
“Burst Lance X! Brionac X!”
I smashed through the wall with a bang and broke down the fence as well, creating an escape route. Now all we have to do is go through there, and we’ll easily get away.
“Whoa… that’s a pretty forceful method…”
“Come on, everyone, let’s go quickly.”
The queen gave the command.
“W-What’s going on!?”
It seems the guards heard the noise and are coming.
“We’ll make a quick escape.”
“This is an incredibly brute-force escape.”
“Sometimes, brute force is the most effective method. I feel like I just saw that in action.”
Ren and Itsuki followed me, looking a bit exasperated. Ah, the guard monsters seem to have noticed us, but they’re not approaching.

Have they realized they can’t win? The guards looked like they were going to give chase, but we had already made our escape and slipped into the back alleys of the town. They’ll probably tighten security soon, but by then, we’ll be long gone through Portal. Even if we do get caught, the queen’s authority can cover it up. After all, we can just claim it was a secret inspection by the queen. Father had used healing magic on the unconscious slave on his back and cast an awakening spell to recruit her.
“B-Buh…?”
“You’re awake? We’re still in the middle of escaping, but unless you agree to join our party, we won’t be able to get away. I know it’s a lot to ask, but could you agree?”
Father pleaded desperately.
“Rifana, stay with me!”
“By the way, is this child big Sister… the one named Raphtalia?”
I called out to the one I assumed was big Sister.
“Yes… I’m Raphtalia.”
Hmm… her smile looks a bit off. It looks like she’s forcing herself to smile. That fixed smile feels unnatural. But somehow, I can tell this is definitely big Sister.
“And that… um, person over there, who is that?”
Phew, that was close. I almost said “pig.” If I arouse suspicion now, it’s all over. I still need big Sister’s permission to marry Filo-tan.
“She’s my friend! Please, help her!”
Oh, she’s big Sister’s friend? That means she’s human, not a pig.
Huh? My memory is bringing up an image of Keel protesting.

But she’s not going to transform into a pig like Keel, is she? Father was giving the awakened child some medicine. It’s a slightly stronger version than the regular healing potion. The queen is well-prepared. Covered in sweat and blood, looking a bit filthy, yet Father is tending to her without a hint of hesitation. As expected, he’s a kind person.
“I think she’ll be fine now. All that’s left is for her to accept the party invitation, and we can escape.”
“Rifana… is that right? Please, I’m asking you. Just accept the invitation we sent.”
“Y-Yes…”
With a ping, the party interface displayed the addition of a new member.
“Now, let’s get out of here! Portal Spear!”
With that, I swiftly activated the teleportation skill and completed our escape.
